cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The title property directly returns user-controlled input (from get_full_title() or Title()) without proper sanitization, which can lead to XSS when rendered in HTML.
The render method directly incorporates the unsanitized title property into output, making it vulnerable to XSS when the output is rendered in a web page.
